messages.subject: How to plot vertical lines at each x location
parts:
I have a data set
flight maxes mins
1 1 6.850000 -2.13333333
2 2 1.483333 -6.63333333
3 3 5.433333 -0.66666667
4 4 7.733333 -0.25000000
5 5 3.033333 -1.70000000
6 6 10.766667 -0.08333333
...
and would like to use ggplot2 to make a vertical line from mins to maxes
at each flight. But none of the standard ggplot2 functions seems to do this.

Any suggestions?

Thanks,
Jim Rome

messages.subject: Re: How to plot vertical lines at each x location
parts:
Hi Jim,

What about geom_linerange?

ggplot(dat, aes(x = flight)) +
geom_linerange(aes(ymin = mins, ymax = maxes))

## also looking at

str(dat)

## its a little weird to have two arrays in a data frame
dat[, c("maxes", "mins")] <- lapply(dat[, c("maxes", "mins")], as.numeric)
str(dat)

Hope this helps,

Josh
